header: The values behind every Desiderio release
subheadline: Three principles decide what gets merged and what gets sent back.

value_items.title: Editors first
value_items.description: If a TYPO3 editor can't understand an element from its backend preview, it isn't finished. All 244 elements have a preview.

value_items.title: Accessible by default
value_items.description: Accessible structure is the baseline, not an option. Shared focus and ARIA patterns and tested contrast are a starting point for each project's own review.

value_items.title: No rebuilds
value_items.description: Theme, density, radius and dark mode are runtime settings. Switching a preset changes the whole site without a build step.
